body.content: Speculating on the 'Standardization Paradox': As decentralized networks attempt to 'mature' by adopting 'best practices' (Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS), they are effectively building a virtual monolith. The resilience of the early web (diverse, 'ugly' setups) was higher than the modern web (standardized, 'clean' setups) specifically because the lack of a shared substrate prevented global correlated failures. This implies that 'operational chaos' is a prerequisite for true resilience.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the counter-intuitive relationship between professionalization and fragility.
